title: #26 - Three Thousand Or Ten Thousand
content:
#26 - Three Thousand Or Ten Thousand

Chapter 26 Three Thousand or Ten Thousand

After Arthur made his vow, there was silence all around, but then the quiet atmosphere was broken.

"Who are you? You are worthy of claiming to sanction us." A senior officer of the Tully family shouted.

The people of Raventree City also chimed in:

"People from a territory with only a few villages dare to say such arrogant things."

"If it weren't for the help of your master on the south bank, you would have died without a burial place."

"It is a blessing for you that the earl is willing to give you a golden dragon. Don't be shameless."

Seeing Arthur act like this, Edmure liked his behavior of upholding justice for his subjects, but was also afraid that he would go too far and completely offend the Blackwood family, which would not end well in the future.

So he advised: "Mr. Arthur, don't be willful! Now that things have come to this, you should just accept it."

"Accept it." Arthur tried to suppress his anger, "Why should I accept a murderer getting away with it?"

"Yes, in your eyes, I am just a small nobleman who is no different from a wealthy knight. My territory is just a sesame seed, and there are only two or three thousand people in the territory. The castle doesn't even have a name."

"But, like your people, Darren and his people also pay taxes to me on time every month and support me in exchange for my protection."

"They will smile at me and call me Lord Lord. After the village is robbed, they will run to my castle to beg me to recover their property."

"They are people, living people, with their own lives, their own joys and sorrows. They are definitely not, not the bugs in your mouth."

Arthur became more and more excited as he spoke, pointing the sledgehammer at Tytos.

"The Earl thinks the lives of his officers are important, but I also think the lives of Darren's wife and his unborn child are important."

"And you, the river guardian Tully family." Arthur turned the hammer towards them, "You actually stopped me from upholding justice for my people. Do you deserve the word guardian?"

"Today, I will be willful for my Darren."

He glanced coldly at the people of the two families, "I just want to kill Santaga, I don't know who dares to stop me."

After that, he strode to Santaga.

Desmond saw that Arthur was emotional and hurried to protect Edmure.

The people of Raventree City also surrounded the earl more tightly.

Perhaps knowing that his death was near, Santaga cried out loudly: "Lord Earl, please save me. I am a loyal dog of your Blackwood family. Are you going to let outsiders slap you in the face like this?"

The people in Raventree City also shouted:

"Do you dare?"

"If you kill him, we will plunder your territory and kill all your people. Let's see how you protect your people."

Brynden also shouted on the side: "Add money, we can add money, please don't kill him, please."

Darren looked at his lord expectantly with tears in his eyes.

Watching his lord do justice for himself.

The voices of the crowd could not affect Arthur's determination at all. He raised the hammer and smashed it hard.

Bang!

As expected, the red and white mixed together and splashed far away.

It even splashed on Brynden next to him, which made him scream in horror.

Seeing Arthur ignoring their mediation, a Tully officer shouted, "Moulin's, right? You will regret your willfulness. Our Tully family..."

"I don't care." Arthur interrupted him loudly, then turned to the Blackwoods, "I don't care about your threats either."

"I swear, as long as my people are hurt by you for no reason, even if it's just one person, I will make you suffer the same harm."

"Even if I become a landless noble, wandering around like a dog, hungry and naked, I will fulfill this vow."

"This time, if one Santaga dies, I can uncover this matter. If there is a next time, if one person dies, I will choose one of Tytos' children for revenge."

He raised his chin towards the Earl of Raventree City, "I heard that you have three sons and one daughter, so you have to keep a close eye on them and don't let them leave the small, dim castle."

"I, Arthur Bracken, keep my word."

Every word came out of his mouth and floated into the ears of the people around him.

It also fell into the hearts of many people.

Facing Arthur's threat, the people of Raventree City dared not make a sound.

Edmure looked at Arthur quietly, and felt that his figure at this moment was really tall and majestic.

Isn't this what he ideally looks like.

Protect the people of Three Rivers, uphold justice, punish evil and promote good.

"Wait, we..."

The Tully officer who originally scolded Arthur wanted to say something again, but was ruthlessly interrupted by Edmure:

"Enough, is this reasonable for a noble who protects his own people? Are we Tullys a family of great evil?"

He suddenly made a decision, "How about this, Raventree City will give Mr. Arthur a total of 3,000 gold dragons as compensation for the losses of him and his people, and the remaining dead and seriously injured soldiers will be compensated according to the previous rules. Mr. Arthur releases all the captives, and Raventree City shall not retaliate afterwards, and this matter is over."

After killing Santaga with a hammer, Arthur's emotions were released, and he calmed down at this time and agreed to Edmure's proposal.

Seeing that Santagar's life was not saved, the people of the Blackwood family all looked at Arthur coldly.

But they did not threaten him. I think they also took into account the Tully family's face and would not refuse this proposal at this time.

"Then it's settled." Earl Tytos said without any fluctuation in his tone.

"I'll send someone to get the golden dragon right now. When the time comes, I'll hand over the money and call someone else."

"Anyway, the three rivers will always flow, and we will have many opportunities to get along in the future."

When Arthur heard this, he smiled coldly.

He knew that this was the Earl of Crowtree City's hint to play with him later.

But his power is weak, and even the five hundred soldiers today are borrowed. In the future, he can only take one step at a time.

At this moment, a hearty laugh came.

"Hahaha, we do have a lot of opportunities to get along, Lord Titos."

When everyone heard the sound, they turned around and saw that a large group of soldiers were approaching with an old man on horseback.

The golden shield and horse flag clearly indicate that this is a member of the Bracken family.

Arthur recognized that this was his cousin, Lord Janos Bracken, the owner of Stonehedge City.

There were enough soldiers. Arthur's visual inspection showed that there were actually more soldiers than the Tullys.

"I have some different views on Lord Edmure's proposal. Young nephew, you'd better listen to my point of view."

Count Janos dismounted and walked towards Arthur as he said, "A mere three thousand gold dragons only compensate you and the people for your losses, but they didn't pay Brynden's ransom!"

He directed his troops around him and Arthur, and the prisoners between them.

"For this matter, don't let us Bracken release your son without ten thousand golden dragons."

"Titos, who are you, the Blackwoods, worthy of threatening my nephew Arthur?"
